codeSystems.name: BodyRegionCS
codeSystems.title: Body region
codeSystems.description: Where on the body something is. This exists so a clinician can TAP A DIAGRAM instead of typing - required for documenting unexplained injuries in children, and used the same way by the one field-hospital system with a published evaluation. Every code is somewhere a person can point at.
